An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Every claim climbs the marble of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the umber re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
